cannotChange.message: Stop the fiddle before you change the Electron version.
cannotChange.description: Error when the user picks another Electron version while the fiddle runs or bisects.

versionUnknown.description: Toast when a window loads or restores an Electron version that isn't in the release list, often followed by the 'fallback' sentence; also the console or CLI error when a run asks for one.

versionUnsupported.message: Electron {{version}} can't run on this computer.
versionUnsupported.description: Toast when a window loads a version this OS or processor can't run; also the console or CLI error when a run asks for one.

localBuildUnknown.message: That local build isn't added anymore.
localBuildUnknown.description: Toast when a window restores a local Electron build that was removed from the list.

localBuildMissing.message: The local build “{{name}}” is missing its Electron binary.
localBuildMissing.description: Toast, or console error at run time, when the chosen local Electron build's folder no longer has Electron in it. {{name}} is the build's name.

downloadFailed.description: Toast, console line or CLI error when downloading a version fails. {{version}} is the Electron version, {{message}} the error, in English.

fallback.description: Toast after the app switched the window to another version. {{problem}} is one of the sentences above; {{fallback}} is e.g. 'Electron 43.0.0' or a local build's name.

electronVersion.description: A release in the messages above, e.g. 'Electron 43.0.0'. {{version}} is a version number such as 43.0.0.

showStableTitle.description: Confirmation after loading an Electron docs example whose version is a stable release, while stable releases are hidden in Settings.

showBetaTitle.description: Confirmation after loading an Electron docs example whose version is a beta or alpha, while beta releases are hidden in Settings.

showNightlyTitle.description: Confirmation after loading an Electron docs example whose version is a nightly, while nightly releases are hidden in Settings.

showChannelDetail.message: This example uses Electron {{version}}, and the version list hides releases like it. Show them, so you can pick this version again later?
showChannelDetail.description: Detail of the show-releases confirmation. Saying no keeps the version but leaves the list as it is.

showChannelOk.description: Confirm button: turns the release channel on in Settings.

switchToBuild.description: Confirmation when the folder picked for a new local build is already added. {{name}} is that build's name.

switchToBuildDetail.message: This folder is already added as a local build.

switchButton.description: Confirm button: uses the already-added local build.

refreshFailed.message: Couldn't refresh the list of Electron releases. Check your connection and try again.
refreshFailed.description: Toast when refreshing the release list from the Versions page fails, usually because the computer is offline.

removeFailed.message: Couldn't remove Electron {{version}}. A file may be in use.
removeFailed.description: Toast when removing a downloaded Electron version fails. {{version}} is the version, e.g. 43.0.0.
